summary: Restrict protocol activation to draft versions so ACTIVE rows cannot be redundantly mutated or audited.
Preserve draft activation and sibling retirement while adding a focused lifecycle boundary.
limits: Four runtime cases execute actual protocol service, rules and repository with mock-state, id, audit and type-only export adapters. Same-code retirement, unrelated protocol preservation and unchanged participant pins are observed in fixture state.

No route auth, native application, concurrent activation or durable audit was executed. The real repository mutates state before audit; audit failure leaves activation applied. No rollback guarantee is added.
